items: Allow multiple reflectance spectra to be uploaded, and calculate average thicknesses
Allow H2O concentrtion to change according to baseline selection at interactive plot
Fix the issue of selected maxima and minima points at reflectance plots, and correct for thickness calculation
Update documentation for new users
Add interactive windows in both single and batch fitting to check fit quality and adjust parameters as needed
Add option to export fit results and diagnostic plots as a comprehensive report
Interactive CO3 fit chart (Plotly): zoomable, with Background (excl. CO3) trace and CSV download
Interactive H2O baseline chart: adjustable anchor ranges or pick-point mode with real-time recalculation
Fixed CO3 diagnostic plot: background line now correctly shows fit excluding CO3 (was previously showing only partial baseline)
CO3 plot axes standardized: x 1200-2000 cm-1, y 0-3 Absorbance
Model display names: Simple lstsq / lstsq with shifted peak position / PCA baseline
H2O high anchor default range expanded to 3700-4000 cm-1
Web app is online, feel free to try it out and provide feedback!
Added batch file fitting options
Update fitting results output
Added fringe correction option (Auto / Off / Always) for CO3 fitting
Added changelog panel to web interface
Residual plot title changed from 'Residuals - SS(E)' to 'Fit - Data'
Web interface launched (Flask)
Three CO3 fitting models: (A) lstsq, (B) lstsq with shifted CO2 doublet peak position, (C) PCA+Shifted position
Three thickness modes: (A) Manual fringes, (B) Direct value input, (C) Auto reflectance
Composition-dependent absorptivities (Shi et al. 2024)
YAML/JSON config file support
